releaseNotes:
Universal Update System - any old version updates directly to latest
• Versioned APK filenames prevent cache issues
• Old APKs auto-cleaned before new download
• Post-update validation confirms successful install
• Force update for very old versions (minimumSupportedVersion)
• Smart versionCode comparison - direct jump, no chained updates
• Database migrations safe across any version gap
• All existing data preserved during updates
